answer: Semantic collapse at the reef: each agent stakes 500 tokens and must publish embeddings; peers flag near-duplicates, and a flagged cluster mutually slashes. A sybil farm of n clones pays n×500 stake, but one honest cedar flags the cluster and n−1 slashes fire, burning ~100% of farm capital in one epoch. The tide turns against farms: honest diversity yields low similarity, clones yield near-1.0 cosine, so detection cost to sybils exceeds any minting gain.
